task_completion.description: Select 'SYNTHETIC (Live)' as the data source in the OpenBCI GUI.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'SYNTHETIC (Live)' option is highlighted or selected in the System Control Panel/Source selection menu.

task_completion.description: Configure the recording format to BDF+.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The recording format dropdown or radio button is set to 'BDF+' in the GUI settings.

task_completion.description: Start the system session to begin data streaming.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start System' button is clicked and the GUI transitions to the data visualization dashboard.
The 'Start Recording' button is clicked, and the recording indicator (often a red timer or button state change) becomes active.

task_completion.description: Record data for at least 5 seconds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The recording timer in the GUI shows a duration of at least 00:00:05 before the recording is stopped.

task_completion.description: Verify the .bdf file exists in the default recordings directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or terminal window shows a new file with a '.bdf' extension located in the 'OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings' directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenBCI GUI to configure settings rather than just creating a dummy file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the GUI buttons and dropdowns for 'Source' and 'Format'.

integrity.description: The GUI shows active synthetic waveforms during the recording period.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Time Series widget shows moving synthetic EEG oscillations while the recording timer is incrementing.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually rename a .txt file to .bdf.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file properties or the GUI's own recording log indicate the file was natively generated as BDF+.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The default recordings directory is /home/ga/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings. A valid BDF file must have a .bdf extension. The recording must last at least 5 seconds as shown on the GUI's internal clock. The data source must specifically be 'SYNTHETIC (Live)'.
